summary: Compute a day-of-year climatology from a published collection and publish it as a new GeoZarr dataset

parameters.name: dataset_id
parameters.description: ID of the published GeoZarr collection to load (as listed under /datasets). Must cover the reference period.

parameters.name: output_dataset_id
parameters.description: ID of the normal dataset to publish. Must have a registered dataset template on the instance (a YAML with sync: {kind: static} and a display block; no ingestion plugin needed).

parameters.name: variable
parameters.description: Variable/band name carried through to the published normal dataset.

parameters.name: temporal_extent
parameters.description: Reference period as [start, end] ISO-8601 date strings, e.g. ["1991-01-01", "2020-12-31"].

parameters.name: smoothing_window
parameters.description: Circular rolling-mean window in days (WMO smoothing). 0 disables. Default 31.
